title: Crypto Trading Signals - June 25, 2026
top_story_headline: Squid (@squidrouter) reveals their public token sale just weeks after announcing their $6m private round.
top_story_comment: $6B+ routed, 1M+ users, 1K+ integrators, and zero exploits gives $QUID a better pre-launch base than the average bridge-adjacent token; the hard part is mapping token value to a router that already sells itself on low fees. Legion + Kraken Launch makes this a distribution/compliance play too, with Legion Score allocations and Kraken’s exchange funnel doing the community-screening work. If incentives flow to solvers and integrators, $QUID has a job; if it lands as governance cosplay, users will keep treating routing as a commodity.
